title: malaxis metallica

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis metallica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
